PREREGISTRATION_INTEGRITY.implication: There is currently no previously confirmed 2v2 latent crossover method to scale. The PASS branch is the only path that authorizes successful-method scaling.

RSCFT_PASS.trigger: sealed RSCFT EVAL writes CROSSOVER_CONFIRMED (or equivalent primary-gate PASS) on the frozen protocol, with no integrity-required flag that voids the claim
RSCFT_PASS.scaling_claim: Does the confirmed RSCFT specialization scale to 4v4 and 6v6?
minimum_honest_stack_at_each_larger_team: train pole specialists (team-size-specific; 2v2 SAPPO teachers cannot load)
team-size-specific causal collection / bank (Phase 0/1 machinery re-measurement)
crossover EVAL on frozen sealed protocol
RSCFT_PASS.why_pi_G_is_load_bearing: Crossover only measures within-policy contrasts V(z0,A)-V(z1,A) and V(z1,B)-V(z0,B). It cannot answer whether a single non-latent policy would have performed just as well. The paper needs both: functional latent specialization AND advantage over a non-latent generalist.
paper_claims_authorized: advantage over a non-latent generalist (pi_G comparison)
RSCFT_PASS.nature_of_4v4_6v6_work: re-measurement, not re-discovery. Machinery exists and is guarded; specialists, incumbent, causal bank, and deployment distribution are team-size-specific and must be budgeted as compute.

RSCFT_FAIL.trigger: sealed RSCFT EVAL writes CROSSOVER_NOT_CONFIRMED, or any integrity-required flag that voids a PASS claim
RSCFT_FAIL.honest_conclusion: No tested latent method has yet produced confirmed 2v2 crossover
forbidden: pretend there is a best confirmed latent method to scale
spend ~140 GPU-hours reproducing the full RSCFT stack at 4v4/6v6 solely to ask whether a 2v2 failure disappears at larger team size
frame any larger-team run as successful-method scaling

optional_narrower_pivot_if_useful.question: Does latent conditioning still provide measurable behavioral or performance structure relative to a generalist as team size increases, even though strict crossover was not confirmed?

optional_narrower_pivot_if_useful.status_of_failed_2v2_crossover: important negative result; do not outrun it with team size
